defects.found: 2026 holds seven months of carrier data, so any 2026 annual figure is a partial year
defects.rule: annual turnaround questions never ask about 2026; the generator excludes it

defects.found: carriers enter and leave the data mid year, so some carrier years have fewer than twelve months
defects.rule: a carrier year is asked about only when it has all twelve months

defects.found: the bank's quarterly metrics run from 2023Q3 to 2026Q3, and the first and last quarter are partial
defects.rule: ledger questions use the full quarters 2023Q4 to 2026Q2 only, as readback's floor does

defects.found: payment share is null on most metro years: micropolitan areas and the years after 2024 have none
defects.rule: a question is drawn only from cells where its measure is not null; a gold with a null drops

defects.found: the year column runs to 2026 while the income based measures stop at 2024
defects.rule: a period with no value is out of range, which is a refusal item, never a lookup

defects.found: a CBSA is either metropolitan or micropolitan, and the micropolitan rows outnumber the metros
defects.rule: metro measures carry the catalog's kind filter, and the gold keeps it as a predicate

defects.found: the upstream build set aside source rows by rule (jammed ACS values and others) in mart_quarantine
defects.rule: no question is drawn from a quarantine mart; a schema block may still list one, as a real table

defects.found: carrier months with flagged flights (duplicate keys, impossible times) are listed in mart_quarantine
defects.rule: no question is drawn from a quarantine mart; a schema block may still list one, as a real table

defects.found: the airport marts cover hundreds of airports, far more than the catalog names
defects.rule: airport questions name only airports in the catalog's entity list

defects.found: the mortgage rate is stored in percent (5.87) beside shares stored as fractions (0.31)
defects.rule: units come from the catalog per measure; a percent never compares with a fraction
